description: relay_client.rs:98-104: on every cache hit the code clones (policy_id.clone(), mode is Copy, mx_patterns.clone()). mx_patterns is Vec<String> which could be large. An Arc<Vec<String>> would allow sharing the patterns across concurrent deliveries without cloning. Alternatively, the enforcement logic could accept a reference and hold the guard while checking, avoiding the clone entirely (the check at step 3 is fast — no await while holding the cached data).
title: enforce_for_delivery clones policy_id, mode, mx_patterns from cache on every hit
